author: Alcina2D
quote: What a boring game—an empty world with nothing to do, just more of the same. Wow, you can jump now for $70, in 2026. It’s disrespectful; I deeply regret spending my money and time on it.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Alcina2D
quote: Just like the one in 2026, but you couldn’t jump. An empty, tedious, soulless game.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: Alcina2D
quote: A game like no other—a look into the future in so many ways. Open worlds will never be the same again! Or perhaps they will, simply due to a lack of interest. Rockstar delivered everything we expected, and then some. I never would have imagined it, but this is the best game ever!
